spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid50
spec.hypothesis: Signed taker-volume imbalance over a trailing 15-minute window predicts the next-30-minute forward return in liquid, tight-spread equity names, net of realistic costs.
spec.power_argument: Basket of top-50 ADV names from the existing 276-name low-vol equity universe (excludes tail-liquidity names implicated in sprint32/34 failures). With entry_per_day_cap=1 per symbol across a ~10-session test window, expect ~400-500 qualifying trades (>=300 threshold met). Given T1 round-trip cost ~5-8bps on liquid names, min detectable/actionable edge set at >=15bps net to be worth pursuing further -- comfortably resolvable at n~450 for a t-stat >=3.
spec.symbols: top-50-ADV subset of current low-vol equity book (exclude tail-liquidity altbasket)
